subject: maths
title: HCF, LCM, Squares & Cubes
welcome_lead: Combine your factor and multiple skills to tackle highest common factors, lowest common multiples, and powers.
meta_desc: Master HCF, LCM, square roots and cube roots in this KS3 maths adventure.
final_note: Powerful! HCF, LCM and roots are now in your toolkit.

concepts.def: Highest Common Factor: largest factor two numbers share.
Lowest Common Multiple: smallest multiple two numbers share.
A number multiplied by itself, e.g. 5² = 25.
A number multiplied by itself three times, e.g. 2³ = 8.
A number that gives the original when squared.
A number that gives the original when cubed.

walkthroughs.body_html:
To find HCF of 12 and 18, list factors:

12: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12
18: 1, 2, 3, 6, 9, 18

Common factors: 1, 2, 3, 6. Highest is 6.

To find LCM of 4 and 6, list multiples:

4: 4, 8, 12, 16.
6: 6, 12, 18.

The smallest common multiple is 12.

mcqs.q: What is the HCF of 16 and 24?
What is the LCM of 3 and 5?
What is the range of the data set [4, 7, 2, 9, 5]?
options: Neither — factors and multiples only apply to prime numbers.
7 — the largest minus the smallest (9 - 2).
5, because that is the middle value.
From 2 to 9 — the range is given as two values.

mcqs.q: Is 12 a factor or a multiple of 4?
options: 5, because that is the middle value.
12 is a multiple of 4 — and 4 is a factor of 12.
12 is a factor of 4 because it includes 4.
Neither — factors and multiples only apply to prime numbers.
3/7, by adding the numerators and the denominators separately.
11/12 — find a common denominator: 8/12 + 3/12.
Neither — factors and multiples only apply to prime numbers.
2/12, by multiplying instead of adding.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “LCM”?
options: Lowest Common Multiple: smallest multiple two numbers share.
A number multiplied by itself, e.g. 5² = 25.
A number that gives the original when squared.
Highest Common Factor: largest factor two numbers share.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Square root”?
options: A number that gives the original when squared.
Lowest Common Multiple: smallest multiple two numbers share.
Highest Common Factor: largest factor two numbers share.
A number that gives the original when cubed.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Square number”?
options: A number that gives the original when cubed.

A number that gives the original when squared.
A number multiplied by itself, e.g. 5² = 25.
